newsitem.title: CHINA: Foreign insurer income 0.74 pct of China total.
newsitem.headline: Foreign insurer income 0.74 pct of China total.

text.p: The annual premium income of foreign insurers last year was 575 million yuan ($69.2 million), accounting for 0.74 percent of the total, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
Total premium income last year was 77.66 billion yuan, it said.
Annual insurance premium income is expected to grow to 200-250 billion yuan by the end of the century, from 61.57 billion yuan in 1995, the newspaper said.
By the end of last year 99 foreign insurers had set up 155 representative offices in China, but only four have branches in China.
